meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 清理前它会先用回归测试把文件现有的行为锁住,再按类别清掉改动文件里 AI 生成的多余代码——废话注释、过度防御、重复、死代码等,最后跑测试和检查验证;验证不过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop、或去掉最近改动里的 AI 代码味时触发。默认范围是分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可以直接传入指定文件列表。

say.text: 清理我当前分支相对 main 的改动,先把行为用测试锁住再动手。
say.note: 会先跑测试确认是绿的,再分类清理。

say.text: 只清理 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 这两个文件。
say.note: 把传入的文件列表当作清理范围。

say.text: 动手前先把每个文件要删什么、改什么列给我看。
say.note: 会先输出清理计划再执行。

howto.what_en: Before touching code it locks current behavior with regression tests, then removes AI-generated smells from changed files, and verifies with tests and checks; it reverts when verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; an explicit file list can be passed instead.

say_en.text: Clean up my branch diff against main, locking behavior with tests first.
say_en.note: Runs tests green before any cleanup.

say_en.text: Only clean up src/foo.py and src/bar.py.
say_en.note: Uses the file list you pass as scope.

say_en.text: Show me the per-file cleanup plan before you change anything.
